Here's what every setting in Strokeberry does, in one minute.
Pencil or Ink? Pencil draws soft, sketchy strokes. Ink draws bold, clean lines, great for logos.
The drawing pencil follows every stroke. Turn it off if you only want the lines.
Bring in the colour to finish in full colour, or switch it off for pure line art.
Duration sets the pace. Ten seconds is punchy, sixty is relaxing. Fifteen to twenty works best for Reels.
Then pick a format: sixteen by nine for YouTube, nine by sixteen for Reels, TikTok and Shorts, or square for the feed.
Your image always fits. Nothing gets cropped.
Now make it yours. Open the studio and try every setting.
